facts.fact: Vero 罕见换下修女服扮吸血鬼，Kayla 忍住没问
facts.anchor: Vero walks in wearing a full vampire costume

facts.fact: Vero 揭 Brawley 戴恶魔角的过程：抗争二十分钟，败在撅嘴
facts.anchor: He fought me on those for twenty minutes. But he is a sucker for a pout

facts.fact: Clay 进门即拒穿戏服，最终只接过 Vero 递的黑色面具
facts.anchor: I’m not wearing a stupid fucking costume

facts.fact: 四人带 Kayla 夜游万圣节儿童活动，Vero 说「Kayla 得以体验」
facts.anchor: We are taking you around the island tonight. It’s a kids’ event for Halloween

facts.fact: Vero 靠物理全中套圈赢来巨型玩偶，转身送给缺牙女巫帽小女孩
facts.anchor: He hands her the teddy, and her toothless smile is contagious

facts.fact: Clay 水枪全中后默默递来黑猫玩偶就走，Ares 评「非常 Clay 的方式」
facts.anchor: Clay walks over to me and hands me a stuffed black cat, but he says nothing and keeps walking

facts.fact: 摩天轮上 Kayla 对 Ares 承认：不敢相信幸福，总等另一只鞋落地
facts.anchor: I didn’t think I was allowed to be happy like this. I keep waiting for the other shoe to drop

facts.fact: 篝火边 Kayla 答 Brawley：完美，同时自问何德何能享此平静
facts.anchor: it was perfect,” I say, staring at the fire and wondering what I did to deserve this kind of peace
